title: Peek becomes unresponsive during repeated JPEG preview

status.label: Related memory fix merged; verify hang coverage
status.detail: PR #34484 fixes unmanaged bitmap leakage. It may explain repeated-preview failure, but the reported unclosable process has not been confirmed resolved.

next_action.label: Validate JPEG navigation after bitmap disposal fix
next_action.reason: Check the merged fix before proposing duplicate disposal work; distinguish memory growth from a remaining hang.

judgment.rationale: The report supplies repeated JPEG navigation and a ZIP. A concrete merged disposal fix addresses a related mechanism, so first validate its coverage rather than inventing a competing fix.
evidence: 0.82.0 report describes repeated JPEG previews, unresponsiveness and inability to close the process; a ZIP and screenshot are attached.
The sole commenter explicitly connects the symptom to #33593 and proposed fix #34484, without guaranteeing resolution.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/34484 merged on 2024-09-16; FilePreview.xaml.cs now disposes replaced disposable previewers according to its description.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/45402 is closed unmerged; its author states the change was an empty placeholder, not an implementation.
judgment.recommended_action: Exercise repeated JPEG navigation on a build containing #34484 and investigate any remaining unresponsiveness separately.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR #34484 addresses the unmanaged-bitmap leak raised in the discussion. Coverage is plausible but partial: no reviewed evidence proves it fixes the unclosable hang. Closed placeholder PR #45402 is not a shipped fix.

issue_context.summary: Peek stopped responding while cycling JPEG images; a subsequently merged previewer-disposal fix targets a related bitmap leak, but end-to-end hang resolution remains unverified.
known_information: The report includes a diagnostic ZIP and screenshot from 0.82.0.
The suggested memory-leak fix #34484 is merged and includes a described sustained-memory navigation test.
Direct issue-specific PR #45402 was closed because it contained placeholder code.
The issue remains open and unassigned.
inferences: Resource exhaustion could explain repeated-preview failure, but inability to terminate may indicate a separate mechanism.
issue_context.analysis: Do not claim the issue is solved from a related merge, and do not count a closed empty PR as implementation. Existing concrete disposal work should be validated before duplicating it.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the report, full discussion, timeline and related PR search.
Read #34484's merged state, affected files, disposal explanation and manual validation; read #45402's unmerged state and placeholder closure comment.
Identified src/modules/peek/Peek.FilePreviewer/FilePreview.xaml.cs as the previewer lifetime owner; the attached ZIP was not downloaded or analyzed.

actions.label: Verify JPEG hang after merged disposal fix

reproduce.version: A current stable build confirmed to contain merged PR #34484
prerequisites: A folder of varied JPEG images and a developer process-memory view.
Use a normal interactive session; do not assume the old hang is reproduced.
steps: Open a JPEG in Peek and repeatedly navigate forward/back through the image folder.
Record process memory over several minutes and after repeated previewer replacement.
Close Peek normally and check that its UI remains responsive and releases previews.
If a hang occurs, record whether memory is growing and whether normal close works; capture a developer hang trace to distinguish disposal from another wait.
reproduce.expected_result: Memory remains bounded during repeated navigation and the window remains closable. A remaining hang is not dismissed solely because #34484 merged.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Prepare a local folder of ordinary generated JPEG test images with varied dimensions, without private photos, for repeated Peek navigation and memory measurement.
